english: I study Spanish to be able to talk with my neighbors.
spanish: Estudio español para poder hablar con mis vecinos.

english: This book is for you; I think you'll enjoy it.
spanish: Este libro es para ti; creo que te va a gustar.

english: We need to leave early in order to avoid traffic.
spanish: Tenemos que salir temprano para evitar el tráfico.

english: I am saving money to buy a car.
spanish: Estoy ahorrando dinero para comprar un carro.

english: She works for an international company.
spanish: Ella trabaja para una empresa internacional.

english: I sent the documents by email this morning.
spanish: Envié los documentos por correo electrónico esta mañana.

english: Thank you for helping me with the move.
spanish: Gracias por ayudarme con la mudanza.

english: I bought these flowers for my mother.
spanish: Compré estas flores para mi mamá.

english: This medicine is for people with allergies.
spanish: Este medicamento es para las personas con alergias.

english: We are going to the coast for the weekend.
spanish: Vamos a la costa para el fin de semana.

english: I have to finish this report by Friday.
spanish: Tengo que terminar este informe para el viernes.

english: Could you call me around eight?
spanish: ¿Podrías llamarme para las ocho?

english: I need a table for four people.
spanish: Necesito una mesa para cuatro personas.

english: This room is too small for all of us.
spanish: Esta habitación es demasiado pequeña para todos nosotros.

english: In my opinion, this is the best solution.
spanish: Para mí, esta es la mejor solución.

english: For a beginner, you speak very well.
spanish: Para ser principiante, hablas muy bien.

english: He is too young to drive.
spanish: Él es demasiado joven para manejar.

english: I don't have enough time to finish everything.
spanish: No tengo suficiente tiempo para terminar todo.

english: We need a bigger box to fit all the books.
spanish: Necesitamos una caja más grande para que quepan todos los libros.

english: I use this app to practice listening every day.
spanish: Uso esta aplicación para practicar la comprensión auditiva todos los días.

english: She went to the pharmacy to buy some medicine.
spanish: Ella fue a la farmacia para comprar unos medicamentos.

english: I brought a jacket in case it gets cold.
spanish: Traje una chaqueta por si hace frío.

english: This key is for the front door.
spanish: Esta llave es para la puerta principal.

english: The train leaves for Guadalajara at six.
spanish: El tren sale para Guadalajara a las seis.

english: Are you ready to go out?
spanish: ¿Estás listo para salir?

english: I need this information for my class.
spanish: Necesito esta información para mi clase.

english: He has a lot of talent for languages.
spanish: Él tiene mucho talento para los idiomas.

english: We are preparing everything for the meeting.
spanish: Estamos preparando todo para la reunión.

english: I made a list so that you wouldn't forget anything.
spanish: Hice una lista para que no se te olvidara nada.

english: Please speak more slowly so that everyone can understand.
spanish: Por favor, hable más despacio para que todos puedan entender.

english: I left early so I wouldn't miss the bus.
spanish: Salí temprano para no perder el autobús.

english: She is studying to become a nurse.
spanish: Ella está estudiando para ser enfermera.

english: I need a few days to think about your offer.
spanish: Necesito unos días para pensar en su oferta.

english: We have until Monday to make a decision.
spanish: Tenemos hasta el lunes para tomar una decisión.

english: This gift is from me to you.
spanish: Este regalo es de mi parte para ti.

english: For now, let's wait for more information.
spanish: Por ahora, esperemos a tener más información.

english: You have to be patient to learn a language.
spanish: Hay que tener paciencia para aprender un idioma.

english: I don't know what to do with all this free time.
spanish: No sé qué hacer con todo este tiempo libre.

english: She is responsible for organizing the event.
spanish: Ella es la encargada de organizar el evento.

english: This neighborhood is very quiet for a big city.
spanish: Este barrio es muy tranquilo para ser una ciudad grande.

english: I bought a notebook for taking notes in class.
spanish: Compré un cuaderno para tomar apuntes en clase.

english: He came here to talk to you.
spanish: Él vino aquí para hablar contigo.

english: I need to find a place to stay for two weeks.
spanish: Necesito encontrar un lugar donde quedarme por dos semanas.

english: I am learning these expressions for my trip to Peru.
spanish: Estoy aprendiendo estas expresiones para mi viaje a Perú.

english: This information is useful for anyone who is learning Spanish.
spanish: Esta información es útil para cualquiera que esté aprendiendo español.

english: I have a question for you, if you have a moment.
spanish: Tengo una pregunta para usted, si tiene un momento.

english: Could you save this seat for me, please?
spanish: ¿Me podría guardar este asiento, por favor?

english: I am calling to ask about your opening hours.
spanish: Llamo para preguntar por su horario de atención.

english: I need to go to the bank to get some cash.
spanish: Necesito ir al banco para sacar efectivo.

english: The package is for Mr. López.
spanish: El paquete es para el señor López.

english: I walk through the park on my way to work.
spanish: Camino por el parque de camino al trabajo.

english: We traveled through Mexico by bus.
spanish: Viajamos por México en autobús.

english: I paid twenty dollars for this shirt.
spanish: Pagué veinte dólares por esta camisa.

english: Thank you for the invitation.
spanish: Gracias por la invitación.

english: I am worried about what happened yesterday.
spanish: Estoy preocupado por lo que pasó ayer.

english: We talked on the phone for almost an hour.
spanish: Hablamos por teléfono durante casi una hora.

english: I usually go for a walk after dinner.
spanish: Normalmente salgo a caminar después de cenar.

english: Could you do this for me, please?
spanish: ¿Podría hacer esto por mí, por favor?

english: I am looking for my glasses.
spanish: Estoy buscando mis lentes.

english: They canceled the game because of the rain.
spanish: Cancelaron el partido por la lluvia.

english: I chose this restaurant because of its good reviews.
spanish: Elegí este restaurante por sus buenas reseñas.

english: The children ran around the house.
spanish: Los niños corrieron por toda la casa.

english: We drove along the coast for several hours.
spanish: Manejamos por la costa durante varias horas.

english: I found your phone under the sofa.
spanish: Encontré tu teléfono debajo del sofá.

english: Please send me the address by text message.
spanish: Por favor, mándame la dirección por mensaje de texto.

english: I prefer to pay by card.
spanish: Prefiero pagar con tarjeta.

english: He made the decision without talking to anyone.
spanish: Tomó la decisión sin hablar con nadie.

english: I have been waiting for you for twenty minutes.
spanish: Te he estado esperando durante veinte minutos.

english: She stayed at home because she was sick.
spanish: Ella se quedó en casa por estar enferma.

english: I did it for you, not for myself.
spanish: Lo hice por ti, no por mí.

english: We passed by your house yesterday.
spanish: Ayer pasamos por tu casa.

english: The bus goes through the center of town.
spanish: El autobús pasa por el centro del pueblo.

english: I am grateful for everything you have done.
spanish: Estoy agradecido por todo lo que has hecho.

english: They are known for their excellent coffee.
spanish: Son conocidos por su excelente café.

english: I am interested in this job because of the schedule.
spanish: Me interesa este trabajo por el horario.

english: He apologized for arriving late.
spanish: Se disculpó por llegar tarde.

english: We had to cancel the trip because of a family problem.
spanish: Tuvimos que cancelar el viaje por un problema familiar.

english: I sent the payment through the bank's website.
spanish: Envié el pago por medio del sitio web del banco.

english: You can reach me by email or by phone.
spanish: Puede comunicarse conmigo por correo electrónico o por teléfono.

english: I heard about the concert through a friend.
spanish: Me enteré del concierto por medio de un amigo.

english: They sell fresh fruit by the kilo.
spanish: Venden fruta fresca por kilo.

english: The apartment costs eight hundred dollars a month.
spanish: El departamento cuesta ochocientos dólares por mes.

english: I exercise three times a week.
spanish: Hago ejercicio tres veces por semana.

english: We stayed there for three nights.
spanish: Nos quedamos allí durante tres noches.

english: He was punished for breaking the rules.
spanish: Lo castigaron por romper las reglas.

english: I couldn't sleep because of the noise outside.
spanish: No pude dormir por el ruido de afuera.

english: She thanked me for being honest.
spanish: Ella me dio las gracias por ser sincero.

english: I am sorry for the misunderstanding.
spanish: Lamento el malentendido.

english: The store is closed for repairs.
spanish: La tienda está cerrada por reparaciones.

english: The road was blocked because of an accident.
spanish: La carretera estaba bloqueada por un accidente.

english: I went out to buy something to eat.
spanish: Salí por algo de comer.

english: Would you go to the store for me?
spanish: ¿Irías a la tienda por mí?

english: I will exchange these shoes for a larger size.
spanish: Voy a cambiar estos zapatos por una talla más grande.

english: We took the wrong road by mistake.
spanish: Tomamos el camino equivocado por error.

english: For some reason, he didn't answer my message.
spanish: Por alguna razón, no respondió mi mensaje.

english: As far as I know, the office is open today.
spanish: Por lo que sé, la oficina está abierta hoy.

english: I can't see anything because of the fog.
spanish: No puedo ver nada por la neblina.

english: The meeting was postponed due to a technical problem.
spanish: La reunión se pospuso por un problema técnico.

english: I am speaking on behalf of my colleagues.
spanish: Estoy hablando en nombre de mis compañeros.

english: You don't have to do everything by yourself.
spanish: No tiene que hacerlo todo por su cuenta.
